scope: Independent visual review of original GM PDF 300 drawing and PDF 301–302 application tables, followed by catalog and builder identity inspection. All 54 callout numbers are accounted for; this does not mean all physical pieces, service kits or installed variants are modeled. Empty selection arrays mean missing independently attributed identities; notes distinguish partial, grouped and unverified candidates. Callout numbers apply only to figure 2P10-004 and are not inherited from Interior or adjacent-year service figures. Original quantities, factory dimensions, tooling, calibrated movement and workshop access remain unverified.

figures.title: 1984–1988 P front-door hardware
figures.application: Drawing 2P10-004/FBS-1865 (printed mark 052286) and PDF 301–302 application tables were independently opened and inspected again. The 1984–88 heading is not blanket interchange evidence. Preserve 1984–85 RH 20352606/LH 20352607 versus 1986–88 RH 20350876/LH 20350877 belt retainers, 1984 push-in versus 1984–88 black hang-on outer seals, 1984 steel versus 1985–88 glass bushings, clear(P37)/tinted glass, manual(P37)/electric regulators and AU3 annotations. Item 34 is now classified as a window-regulator bumper without powerLocks gating; regulator variant and installed position remain unverified. The window-motor W/AU3 annotation remains unresolved. Manual/electric and option alternatives must not be summed as original installed parts. Relay 19 remains missing rather than replaced by another-family relay.
